introduction: ^Hi! I saw this number in an ad online, I was wondering if you could help get my coworker off my back for once?
^I'm not sure what you can do exactly... I mean I don't want her dead or anything, and definitely no kind of injury she would probably just try and milk it for attention...
^No, no. Maybe you could just change her mind, can you do that? Just make her forget me or just so she no longer hates me.
questions: ^(Gather some more info or CLICK the phone again to hang up)
^What inspired you to make this wish?
^Any other details you can give me?

c-0: ^Bethany, 22. I'm an entry level accountant at a pretty major firm for where i'm from, in fact my father used to own the company until not long after I got the job.
c-1: ^I feel like ever since I got this job that damn grouch Melinda has been always out to get me, it's like she has some deep-rooted personal grudge against me but whenever I've confronted her she simply just says that I "dont belong here".
c-2: ^Not that I can think of, I just want this all to be over with so everyone will stop acting so strange around me. I know she's been working here for a very long time but it's still crazy that they all tiptoe around me whenever she's nearby.
